lines.text:
SABRINA: ...It’s true that psychic power is
a potent ability.\c
However, there are things that cannot be
overcome with that power alone.\c
I finally understand that now, after losing to you
in our last battle.\c
I won’t be relying on just psychic power this time.
My true strength...my true self...
Allow me to test them against you!

SABRINA: I foresaw that you would come here
by looking into the future.\c
But I intentionally didn’t look to see who will
win our battle.\c
Let’s find out now, together!

SABRINA: There was once a time when I was
shocked that I lost to you.
That feeling is gone now.\c
It’s been replaced with a desire to grow strong
and live freely, as you do.
